podcast.title: Cancon Boosted Success (1970s)
podcast.body: Max Webster was one of the Canadian rock talents whose careers received a boost from the Cancon rules in the 1970s, contributing to the development of a national music scene. "Just on the rock side, we had Rush, April Wine, the Guess Who, Triumph, Crobar, Teenage Head, Max Webster, Chilowac, FM, Saga, and a foot-and-cold water."
